title: Search hidden holdout freeze v1
purpose: Freeze the holdout boundary before any repeated agent evaluation without storing holdout answers or fixture material in the repository.

holdout.fixtureGeneration: Generate fresh seeded variants from the benchmark recipes in an external evaluation environment; never reuse development bytes.
holdout.validatorMaterial: not exposed to the evaluated agent

freeze.commitmentPurpose: Commit to holdout seed material before any repeat evaluation; reveal seed only to the independent fixture/oracle runner after trials are isolated.
